scene1_screen1.text: Spotlights bathe the stage in gold. Audience murmurs fade to silence. The podium stands center stage, framed by two banners: "HEART TRUTH: Advocating for the Invisible Diseases."

scene1_screen2.text: The lights dim. A single spotlight warms the wooden podium. Applause ripples like a heartbeat through the auditorium as she steps into view.

scene1_screen3.text: Elena Moreau. Sharp suit jacket over a red turtleneck. Confident. Grounded. A woman whose voice belongs on a battlefield — not because it’s loud, but because it doesn’t flinch.

scene1_screen4.text: She places her notes on the podium… and doesn’t look at them once.

scene1_screen5.text: (firm) Most heart conditions don’t come with warnings. They don’t scream. They whisper. And if you’re a woman — if you’re young — you’re often told it’s “just stress.” Or “just anxiety.” Or “it´s just in your head.”

scene1_screen6.text: She meets the gaze of the audience. Not to impress. To connect.

scene1_screen7.text: I was twelve when I collapsed for the first time. Twenty, when I realized doctors were treating my symptoms, not my disease. And I’m still here — not because of miracles, but because I refused to be quiet.

scene1_screen8.text: Applause swells again — longer this time. Someone in the back rises to clap. Others follow.

scene1_screen9.text: In the fourth row, a man watches. Quiet. Still. His eyes burn faintly under the surface of human disguise.

scene1_screen10.text: Jason doesn’t blink. Doesn’t shift. Just listens.

scene1_screen11.text: (thinking) Conviction. Controlled breath. Pulse tight behind the collarbone. No arrhythmic flutter — yet. She knows her limits.

scene1_screen12.text: Elena paces slightly now, off-script, more personal.

scene1_screen13.text: We need faster diagnoses. More funding. Better research. And until then, we need rage. Beautiful, informed rage. The kind that makes the invisible visible.

scene1_screen14.text: The audience rises with her final words. Cheers, claps, even a few tears.

scene1_screen15.text: But as she exits the stage, applause still echoing—

scene1_screen17.text: One hand to her chest. The other braced against the wall. Not dramatic. Not crumpling. But real.

scene1_screen18.text: (breathless) I’m fine. It’s just adrenaline. Happens sometimes.

scene1_screen19.text: People murmur. A staff member moves toward her. She straightens. Smiles. Winks.

scene1_screen22.text: (thinking) Oh no, darling. That wasn’t adrenaline. That was the clock ticking down. I can smell it on you.

scene1_screen23.text: (thinking, darker) That heart won’t hold you past midnight. Not without help. And lucky you — I skipped dinner.

scene1_screen24.text: He rises slowly, blending into the crowd. Not a savior. Not yet.

scene2_screen1.text: The alley reeks of wet pavement, grease, and something more personal — fear. Elena staggers against a wall, one hand pressed to her chest, her breath hitching in sharp, shallow gasps.

scene2_screen3.text: This isn’t new. She’s lived with arrhythmogenic heart failure since she was twelve. But tonight it’s different. Faster. Meaner. Her vision fractures like glass under pressure. Her legs buckle.

scene2_screen5.text: She tries to inhale — nothing. Just static in her lungs and the rapid-fire tap of a heart misfiring in panic.

scene2_screen6.text: (thinking) Not here. Not now. Not like this.

scene2_screen7.text: She slides to the ground, trembling fingers scrabbling for her phone… which of course, is dead.

scene2_screen10.text: A tall man steps out of the shadows. Pale skin. Eyes faintly glowing like an old ember refusing to die out. His hair is pristine despite the rain, like the night avoids touching him.

scene2_screen11.text: (strangled, between gasps) Brilliant. Maybe next you can tell me the sky is wet.

scene2_screen12.text: (evenly) I can stop it. But if I do, you won’t be free afterward.

scene2_screen13.text: Her head lolls back against the bricks. Her limbs tremble violently. Somewhere under the panic, her mind tries to rationalize.

scene2_screen14.text: (stepping closer) You’re young. Furious. Not ready to die. That makes you… vulnerable.

scene2_screen15.text: She tries to speak — only a dry rasp escapes.

scene2_screen16.text: Today, as an exception, here´s my proposal. I need a partner. Temporarily. You pretend to be my fiancée at the vampire summit. They leave you alone. I keep you alive. Break the illusion, and they won’t be so merciful.

scene2_screen18.text: He kneels beside her. His presence is strangely comforting — not warm, but anchored, like he knows what to do when everything collapses.

scene2_screen19.text: Say yes, and you’ll live. Say no, and—

scene2_screen20.text: Her body jerks. A sharp, arrhythmic spike in her chest. Her pulse stutters wildly.

opts.text: Take his hand, anything to live
Refuse help from a strange man

scene2_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Her vision swims. The alley spins. Her hand shoots out and grabs his wrist, barely aiming.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen2.text: (through clenched teeth) Deal. Whatever you are — I’m in.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Jason moves with unnatural speed. One arm supports her while the other brushes hair from her neck. She barely feels the bite — just a moment of sharpness, then...

scene2_choice1_option1_screen4.text: Warmth. Real, golden warmth spreading through her chest like summer cracking open the grave.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen5.text: She gasps, limbs jerking as her heart resets, pounding back into rhythm. Her lungs flood with air like it’s the first breath in hours.

scene2_choice1_option1_screen6.text: (softly) You're bound now. Don’t make me regret it.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (through gritted teeth) No. This sounds like the ravings of a madman! I don’t know you. I don’t trust you. I’d rather die than—

scene2_choice1_option2_screen2.text: Her words collapse into a choking sound. She seizes, her body curling inward.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen4.text: Before she can resist, his hand grabs the side of her neck — not cruel, but firm, possessive. His mouth is on her skin before she can protest again.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen5.text: She feels it — the puncture. Then the fire. Then— Color, breath, clarity.

scene2_choice1_option2_screen6.text: She slumps against him, eyes wide in shocked betrayal.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen1.text: (ragged) Why me? Thousands are dying every day. Why pick me in an alley?

scene2_choice1_option3_screen2.text: He tilts his head, his face unreadable. It was noticeable how he was trying to analyze his actions, but at the same time, inside, he was brushing them off.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen3.text: Because you fought harder in thirty seconds than most do in their final hours. Because when you looked at me, you didn’t flinch. Not even now.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen4.text: She blinks. And slowly — maybe out of curiosity, out of surrender — she lifts her hand toward his.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen5.text: The moment they touch, a thread snaps into place. Like something ancient being pulled taut.

scene2_choice1_option3_screen7.text: The bite is almost gentle. What follows… isn’t.

scene2_screen21.text: Elena clutches his coat, breath jagged, heart now steady but reeling.

scene2_screen22.text: (thinking) All this is more like my own delirium and the fact that I have already died, and now I see all sorts of nonsense.

scene2_screen23.text: (muttering) So… you choose dinner based on attitude?

scene2_screen24.text: (flatly) Only if it comes with a side of defiance.

scene2_screen27.text: She blinks, half-delirious, but in the impossibility of resisting his question.

scene2_screen31.text: He lifts her effortlessly. Carries her through the rain like something fragile — but not broken.

scene2_screen32.text: Jason lays her gently on the bed, brushes damp hair from her face, and closes the window with a glance. He doesn’t linger. Doesn’t gloat. But before leaving, he whispers something only the shadows hear.

scene2_screen33.text: (thinking) You've taken the vampire venom treatment much better than most. I hope you live to see tomorrow.

scene2_screen34.text: Outside, the storm finally eases. Inside, the girl who almost died breathes quietly.

scene3_screen1.text: Light filters through the blinds in slow, golden bars. The air is too still. On the nightstand: a glass of water, a bottle of aspirin, and a single dark stain on a folded towel — dried now. No blood. No mess. Just… absence.

scene3_screen2.text: Elena bolts upright in bed. Her heart — steady. Unnervingly steady. No stabbing pain. No skipped beats. Only a strange fog in her head, like her thoughts are wrapped in gauze and humming with someone else’s echo.

scene3_screen3.text: Everything feels… borrowed. Like she’s wearing her own life from the outside.

scene3_screen4.text: (off-screen, calm) Still alive. That’s a relief. I’d hate to be ghosted on our first official outing.

scene3_screen5.text: She turns her head. The realization that yesterday's events were not a dream quickly reached her consciousness, and she had already pulled herself together.

scene3_screen6.text: Jason sits in her armchair, legs crossed, as if he’s lived there for years. Dressed in black again, his coat pristine, his expression maddeningly serene.

scene3_screen8.text: (casually) You invited me in last night. That’s binding. Vampirically speaking, I now qualify as furniture.

scene3_screen9.text: She touches her throat. The skin is unbroken. But the memory — the pain, the warmth — it's still there, pulsing like an aftershock.

scene3_screen10.text: So it wasn’t a dream. I really— You actually—

scene3_screen11.text: (gently interrupting) You’re alive because I gave you part of my blood. That binds us. Temporarily. You’re not immortal — not unless we seal the transition. But you’re tethered. To me. To the pact.

scene3_screen13.text: Jason’s eyes narrow slightly, like a professor sensing a student about to interrupt.

scene3_screen14.text: A blood pact. Very old. Very simple. In exchange for vampire venom — which can repair mortal death — the recipient is spared. Healed. But bound.

scene3_screen15.text: He stands now, slowly — not looming, just inevitable.

scene3_screen16.text: It’s not full subjugation. This isn’t a collar and leash. But within the pact, the saved agrees to serve the vampire's intent — the way a bargain binds both sides. You’re magically prevented from breaking its terms.

scene3_screen18.text: You will play the role of my fiancée at the upcoming Vampire Summit. You will not speak of the truth to anyone — not the Council, not the staff, not your friends. Not even in your dreams.

scene3_screen20.text: Yesterday it sounded crazy, but today... Honestly, I would more easily believe that I was drugged.

scene3_screen22.text: Think of it this way: I cured your death. In return, you get to wear nice dresses, insult ancient bloodlines, and make sure I don’t have to marry someone with three ceremonial daggers in her hair.

scene3_screen23.text: And if I break the pact?

scene3_screen24.text: Then the blood reclaims itself. And so does death.

scene3_screen25.text: They lock eyes. For a second, neither blinks.

scene3_screen28.text: (thinking) Just the thought of trying to escape causes a tightness in my chest. It's not like I'm so suggestible as to feel something impossible.

scene3_screen29.text: Elena took a deep breath, trying to get a grip on herself.

scene3_screen30.text: (thinking) Once I allow myself to accept this new reality, I feel better. Well...

scene3_screen31.text: Elena gets out of bed — slower than usual, testing her balance. She’s solid. More solid than she remembers being in years.

scene3_screen32.text: She sways slightly, like the world tilts around his words. He rises and moves toward her — not rushing, but steady.

scene3_screen33.text: The Council will feel my blood in you. That’ll be enough to fool them. As long as you act as if you were a vampire— they won’t ask questions.

scene3_screen34.text: Elena blinks. The fog in her head thickens for a second. She exhales.

scene3_screen35.text: (hoarse) So what exactly is your plan? Besides breaking into bedrooms and turning women into fake brides?

scene3_screen36.text: (level) Tonight we travel to the capital. At the Summit, I’ll present you as my fiancée.  It’s a political maneuver. A delay. A mask.

scene3_screen37.text: (flat) Of course. Because nearly dying from a congenital heart defect wasn’t enough drama. Let’s toss in court intrigue and cosplay.

scene3_screen39.text: You need to sell it. Not through ballgowns or tiaras — through presence. Confidence.

scene3_screen40.text: He steps back and lifts a hand between them, fingers curved delicately.

scene3_screen41.text: Lesson one. When addressing a high-ranking vampire, you nod — slightly — but never break eye contact. Too deep, and you look submissive. Too flat, and it’s a challenge.

scene3_screen43.text: (dry) ...I was hoping for more of a “makeover montage” situation.

scene3_screen44.text: That’s lesson two. Don’t say things like that where they can hear. Humor confuses them. They assume it's a threat.

scene3_screen46.text: You should get ready. Clean up. Don’t try to look like royalty — just try not to look like you were half-dead yesterday. Now we need you to eat.

scene3_screen47.text: She nods slowly, still piecing herself together.

scene3_screen48.text: Hours later, a quiet restaurant tucked deep in the folds of a forgotten street. Warm light pools on the tablecloth, glinting off old glassware and polished silver. A soft melody hums from hidden speakers. Elena picks at her food. Jason watches her without watching.

scene3_screen49.text: (flat) You need to eat. If you collapse in front of the Elders, someone will accuse me of draining you. And then I’ll have to kill them, and they’ll have to kill me, and it’s a whole etiquette disaster.

scene3_screen50.text: (deadpan) I’m really enjoying how chill this whole situation is.

scene3_screen51.text: She puts the first forkful of puree into her mouth. She takes a bite, swallows without tasting. Her body obeys, but her mind drifts. A sudden flicker — memory slicing through fog:

scene3_screen52.text: She’s twelve. Dad made his signature mashed potatoes. He sits across from her at the table, elbows on the scratched wood, gaze soft but serious.

scene3_screen53.text: (gently) One day, Elena, your heart may give out. It doesn’t mean you will. You’re not broken. You’re just… on a different timeline.

scene3_screen54.text: (quiet) What if it happens when I’m alone?

scene3_screen55.text: (smiling, with pain behind it) Then you hold on as long as you can. And know I love you in every second of it.

scene3_screen56.text: Elena blinks, fork still in hand. The room feels too warm. Her pulse — not racing, but not quite hers.

scene3_screen58.text: I’m thinking about my father. He disappeared when I was seventeen. No goodbye. No trace. Everyone said he left. But I don’t believe that.

scene3_screen59.text: Jason’s watching her. Not hungrily. Then — he speaks. Quiet. Low.

scene3_screen60.text: Not a good topic for a casual dinner, is it?

scene3_screen61.text: I don't think you should be embarrassed. That’s what my blood does. Vampire blood heightens the pain of those who haven't fully transformed, forcing them to do so. Your feelings were speaking to you now.

scene3_screen62.text: Elena swallows. The table between them feels too wide. The world outside their restaurant window is blurry and soft, like a dream half-forgotten.

opts.text: Reach out and let her feel you're here
Distract her with charm and irony

scene3_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Jason watches her fingers tremble as she sets down her fork. The silence between them isn’t peaceful — it’s coiled, restless. He moves slowly, sliding his hand forward on the table. Palm up. Open. An offering, not a command.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Elena hesitates. Her gaze drops to his hand — like she’s deciding whether it’s safe to let someone hold even a fraction of her fear. Then she places her fingertips against his. Just barely touching. But it’s enough.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Her breath steadies. The shaking fades. She doesn’t smile — but her eyes lose some of their storm. Jason doesn’t speak. He just stays there. Present. Anchored.

scene3_choice1_option1_screen4.text: And in that quiet, something steadier than magic takes root. Connection.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen1.text: (mildly) Do you want a survival tip?

scene3_choice1_option2_screen3.text: Worse. Never wear garlic perfume to a Council dinner. One poor intern thought it was chic. It ended in fire. And therapy.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen4.text: A tiny laugh escapes her lips. Tired. But real.

scene3_choice1_option2_screen5.text: Note to self: no spicy floral tones.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen1.text: Jason closes his eyes briefly — just a breath — and focuses. The bond between them pulses. Warmth spreads through Elena’s chest, slow and silken. Like a deep breath drawn from the inside. Her thoughts are quiet. Her fingers stop trembling.

scene3_choice1_option3_screen3.text: A gift. Temporary calm. I thought you could use a break from the storm.

scene3_screen63.text: They exit into the night. The city gleams around them in scattered lights and whispers.

scene3_screen64.text: In the car, Jason drives one-handed, his gaze forward. Elena stares out the window, the night reflecting faintly in her eyes.

scene3_screen66.text: (softly) I'm sorry your father left you. I couldn't hurt a girl like you.

scene3_screen67.text: She doesn’t answer. But her hand brushes the edge of her seat, closer to his. Not touching. But not far.

scene3_screen68.text: (thinking) This all feels like some kind of dream in which I'm still alive, although I shouldn't be, and for some reason, I feel a connection with the kind of vampire who saved me, and is now taking me to the lair of his kind.

scene3_screen69.text: Jason keeps his eyes on the road. The silence between them is no longer heavy — just suspended.

scene3_screen70.text: (thinking) My father was the perfect ruler. Composed. Dutiful. Feared. It's a shame he was killed in a stupid vampire war, even though he was able to change the relationship between vampires and humans.

scene3_screen71.text: (thinking) Everything I do is a carefully staged escape act — from thrones, from choices, from blood. And now I’ve pulled a mortal girl into the middle of it. As if she could fix a world that's already broken.

scene3_screen72.text: (thinking) As if her fierce speech at the university could matter in a place where words are daggers and smiles are traps.

scene3_screen73.text: Ahead, the gates of the capital glint — dark iron wrapped in ivy and menace. Jason exhales, just once.

scene3_screen74.text: (thinking) After all, I could choose the one the main vampires want to see now, to transfer control to them through the necessary connections, but I cannot look so insignificant compared to my father.

scene3_screen75.text: The car doesn’t slow down. The shadows deepen.

scene3_screen76.text: Ahead, black spires pierce the sky. The capital looms. Conveniently, it turned out to be the neighboring city to the one Elena lived in. What is fate if there is no surprise that vampires live right next door?

scene4_screen1.text: Inside, cold fire flickers along the walls. Vampires stand in rows — tall, elegant, inhuman. Their eyes burn in shades no mortal iris should hold: gold, amethyst, mercury. And every gaze cuts through her.

scene4_screen2.text: Jason offers his arm. Not tender — strategic. Like armor. She takes it.

scene4_screen3.text: (thinking) Smile, but not too wide. Don’t show fear. Don’t run. Don’t look away too fast. Let them look. Let them think you belong. If someone challenges the bond — step forward. Don’t wait for Jason. Own it.

scene4_screen4.text: She repeats his words like a prayer — but her heart, traitorous thing, beats too slow. Or maybe not at all.

scene4_screen6.text: From the shadows glides Lord Valentin — silver hair, eyes like frostbite, mouth curved in something cruelly amused.

scene4_screen8.text: (smiling with teeth) Do you still eat half-dead meat?. Charming.

scene4_screen9.text: A ripple of laughter. Jason’s hand tightens around hers — not enough to hurt, just enough to anchor. She doesn’t flinch.

scene4_screen10.text: (calm) Elena is not food. She is my chosen. The bond is sealed. The Council will honor it because she is a vampire.

scene4_screen11.text: The Council expects a real union. Not just blood — vows. Our kind has waited decades for you to marry. If you won't choose a noble daughter, you'd better make this girl glow.

scene4_screen12.text: A hush. Then a tall woman in crimson steps forward, eyes narrowed.

scene4_screen13.text: She smells... odd. Like ash and roses. You, girl — what lineage claims you?

scene4_screen14.text: Elena steps forward, pulse steady only because Jason’s presence hums through her blood like a tether.

scene4_screen15.text: (firm) The kind that bleeds, fights, and doesn't kneel for theatrics.

scene4_screen16.text: The room is still. Then a single, sharp laugh from someone unseen. Jason doesn’t speak — but Elena feels it: pride, flickering like warmth along their bond.

scene4_screen17.text: How... quaint. Very well. Let the Council observe. For now.

scene4_screen18.text: The bell tolls — low, reverberating. The crowd disperses, reluctant but obedient.

scene4_screen19.text: (bowing) The Council extends a formal invitation to the Summit Ball. Tomorrow at dusk. A celebration of your union... and a reminder of the clock.

scene4_screen20.text: Jason’s jaw tightens. Elena feels it before she sees it. They’re stalling. Waiting. Watching. Hoping for cracks.

scene4_screen21.text: Jason leads her to a quiet balcony bathed in moonlight.

scene4_screen22.text: Elena leans on the railing, inhaling cool night air. Her chest aches — not from pain, but the weight of performance.

scene4_screen23.text: (exhausted) So that was the warm welcome?

scene4_screen24.text: They’re sharks in lace. But you held your own.

scene4_screen27.text: She turns to him, silhouetted against the stars.

scene4_screen28.text: (softly) That thing Lord Valentin said. About the marriage. Is it true?

scene4_screen29.text: Jason doesn’t answer right away. He looks out over the courtyard, where a fountain glows faintly.

scene4_screen30.text: (quiet) Yes. The Council wants me bound to one of their own. To unify the clans. To control my claim to the throne.

scene4_screen32.text: I lose everything. The vote. The crown or any say in what comes next. They’ll use me, or erase me.

scene4_screen33.text: Elena crosses her arms, jaw tense.

scene4_screen34.text: So I was a convenient shield?

scene4_screen36.text: He stops. For the first time, there’s hesitation. No act. No mask. Just a flicker of something raw.

scene4_screen38.text: Now I’m not sure I want it to be pretend anymore. I feel a special connection with you.

scene4_screen39.text: This often happens between those who have made a pact, but with you... This connection seems to give strength not only to you, but to me as well. I must admit to you that I have never felt such support before as I feel now.

scene4_screen40.text: (thinking) I'm just in shock... the problem is that I feel this attraction, this connection. As if my salvation became something more — salvation for him, too.

scene4_choice1.text: What do you feel in this moment?

opts.text: Retreat, remind him this is still a deal
Let the bond open — feel him in your blood

scene4_choice1_option1_screen1.text: Elena steps back, arms crossing over her chest. Her voice is tight.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen2.text: You saved me. I play my role under duress and fear of death. That’s the deal. Let’s not make it something it’s not.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Jason nods. But his gaze follows her as she turns away — not possessive, just… lingering.

scene4_choice1_option1_screen4.text: Even if I wasn’t pretending when I said that I would never hurt you?

scene4_choice1_option1_screen5.text: She hesitates — just for a heartbeat — then walks on.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Elena steps closer. Not in challenge — but something almost tender.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen2.text: Her hand finds his jacket, rests lightly over his heart.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen3.text: I feel your affection for me, as I feel mine for you. You don't seem like the type to lie.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen4.text: (hushed) It hasn’t felt like lying for a while now.

scene4_choice1_option2_screen5.text: Their eyes lock. No kiss. No rush. Just tension wound so tight the air trembles with it.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen1.text: She closes her eyes, just for a second — and lets the tether between them stir. Jason’s energy flickers through her chest like heat on cold skin. She feels his protectiveness. His confusion. His wanting.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen2.text: (barely a whisper) You're in my veins. And yet I don’t know where I end and you begin.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen3.text: (gently) Then let’s not find the line tonight.

scene4_choice1_option3_screen4.text: Their foreheads nearly touch. The bond hums — a promise of something deeper, if they dare.

scene4_screen41.text: Far below, the capital pulses with moonlight and quiet malice. But here, the world is still.

scene4_screen42.text: Whatever game the Court plays, one thing is clear: Jason didn’t bring a puppet. He brought fire.

scene5_screen1.text: Jason and Elena feel the vampires' appraising glances on them. The tension is mounting - this ball was meant to be an engagement party.

scene5_screen2.text: (thinking) It would be fair to ask what happens next, but whenever I want to do so, there's a lump in my throat.

scene5_screen3.text: (thinking) One more formal party and it'll drive me crazy.

scene5_screen4.text: As if to reassure her, Jason puts an arm around Elena's waist and gently leads her to the dance floor. It's all so formal that the vampire royalty easily makes way for them.

scene5_screen5.text: Elena’s dress fits like a second skin, yet she feels like she’s wrapped in thorns. The dance just ended — Jason’s hand lingered a moment too long on her waist. She steps away to catch her breath, cheeks still flushed.

scene5_screen6.text: That’s when she feels it — a familiar gaze on her back. A pull, subtle and deep, like a tether tugging at her spine. She turns.

scene5_screen7.text: Elena's breath catches. Her father. Thinner and changed, but it's definitely her father!

scene5_screen9.text: She moves toward him on instinct, each step surreal. Her father’s face is pale — too pale. His eyes gleam with an unnatural sheen.

scene5_screen11.text: Elena throws her arms around him, but he doesn't embrace her fully. Instead, he rests a hand gently on her shoulder — like he’s afraid.

scene5_screen12.text: Where were you? I thought… You vanished. I thought you were dead.

scene5_screen13.text: I was. In every way but name.

scene5_screen14.text: He glances around, as if the walls have ears.

scene5_screen15.text: (low) Lord Valentin. He turned me. Years ago, I begged him to save you — your illness was getting worse. He agreed… in exchange for my servitude. He said when the time came, he’d save you.

scene5_screen17.text: He lied. He never meant to free me. I was useful to him as a silent shadow, an obedient puppet. That’s why I disappeared. That’s why you never heard from me.

scene5_screen18.text: Elena staggers back a step, grief and rage boiling beneath her skin.

scene5_screen19.text: I don't know why, but you're the first person I've ever been able to tell this to! Every time I tried, I couldn't do it!

scene5_screen20.text: (angrily and shocked) A vampire pact! He bound you to a vampire pact, just like the vampire prince did to me!

scene5_screen22.text: Her father nods, expression taut with sorrow.  Lord Valentine's glance was seen by both of them.

scene5_screen23.text: (subduing) Carlos Mora! Come to me, I need help.

scene5_screen24.text: It was an intonation that didn't require any further repetition.

scene5_screen25.text: (thinking) I'm sure that was a special subduing of the damn vampire pact!

scene5_screen26.text: Overwhelmed with emotion, she squeezes her father's hand, as if forced to say goodbye. Unable to resist the order, the father leaves Elena's company. Elena decides to take a break on the balcony so as not to scream from the emotions that overwhelm her, which have been exacerbated by the vampire's poison.

scene5_screen27.text: Elena grips the stone railing with white-knuckled hands, trying to breathe through the firestorm inside her.

scene5_screen29.text: She doesn’t turn. He comes to stand beside her.

scene5_screen30.text: (quiet) Lord Valentin lied to my father. Promised to save me and took him instead. Kept him prisoner. All these years. He bound him with a vampire pact, and now I'm bound by it. You're using us.

scene5_screen31.text: Jason exhales, voice sharp with fury.

scene5_screen32.text: I didn’t know. Elena, I swear to you. I would never lie to you so vilely! If I had—

scene5_screen33.text: (interrupting) Then do something. He deserves more than your sympathy. So do I.

scene5_screen34.text: Jason’s eyes hardened. He looks back toward the ballroom, where Lord Valentin still holds court like nothing happened.

opts.text: Expose Lord Valentin publicly, right now
Handle it quietly, with political precision

scene5_choice1_option1_screen1.text: The ballroom still buzzes with music and hollow laughter when Jason enters. But the air changes as he lifts his voice — royal, resonant, unmistakable.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Enough games. Tonight, I speak not as prince, but as heir of justice.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen3.text: All turn to him. Conversations die. Even Lord Valentin, mid-sentence, stiffens.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen4.text: Years ago, Lord Valentin turned a mortal man under false pretenses — Elena’s father. He forced him into servitude, silenced him with a blood command, and kept his existence hidden. He used this man as leverage to manipulate his daughter — my guest — into a false engagement.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen5.text: That can't be true. If it were, a mortal wouldn't be able to tell anyone!

scene5_choice1_option1_screen6.text: (Interrupting, sternly) Father and daughter are bound by blood stronger than a vampire-human pact. Elena's father was in a mocking pact, but he was able to break it.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen7.text: Gasps ripple through the room like a tide.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen8.text: (coldly) This is a violation of the Old Pact and the Sanctum Accords. For treason, deceit, and binding blood without council approval — I demand Lord Valentin’s arrest.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen9.text: Guards don’t hesitate. But Lord Valentin’s control slips with his composure.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen10.text: (shouting) Oh, listen to you, you only eat half-dead people and have no fun! I don't understand why we stopped enslaving people. It was your father's idea, but he died almost exactly 100 years ago!

scene5_choice1_option1_screen11.text: The hysteria in his voice twists the crowd’s opinion. Disgust flickers in noble eyes. A predator reduced to a madman.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen12.text: (firmly) Lord Valentin, you are hereby removed from the Council. You’ll stand trial at the Tribunal.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen13.text: Lord Valentin is dragged away, ranting. No one stops them.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen14.text: Jason watches until the doors close. Then he turns, eyes searching.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen15.text: Elena stands at the edge of the crowd. Their eyes meet — and something clicks between them. A bond. Forged not by blood, but by choice. She walks to him, slowly.

scene5_choice1_option1_screen17.text: He reaches for her hand. This time, she doesn’t pull away.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen1.text: Jason returns to the ballroom but doesn’t raise his voice. Instead, he moves like a shadow — straight to Lady Virena. They speak in low tones, her face slowly paling.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen2.text: Blood slavery… Despicable. But if it was a pact, then how did Elena find out about it?

scene5_choice1_option2_screen4.text: I’ll see to it. He’ll be removed quietly tonight. No spectacle — but he’ll never return.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen5.text: (Interrupting, sternly) Father and daughter are bound by blood stronger than a vampire-human pact. Elena's father was in a mocking pact, but he was able to break it.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen6.text: Jason nods once. The verdict is silent, but absolute. As if sensing something was wrong, but not wanting to attract attention, Lord Valentine quickly left the room.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen7.text: Later, Elena finds her father waiting near the exit — alone, not guarded, simply resting. She runs to him.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen10.text: He places a hand over her heart.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen11.text: You know, I feel like I'm not as under Valentin's power as I used to be. Like he can command me, but only with words, and not like before, when I felt an inner connection with him.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen12.text: And you… You are free too, now?

scene5_choice1_option2_screen13.text: Jason watches from a distance, a quiet weight on his chest. Elena looks up and meets his gaze. She smiles — faint, but real.

scene5_choice1_option2_screen14.text: It seems my connection is different from yours.

scene5_screen35.text: Later, Jason approaches Elena’s father — now seated in the garden. He kneels before the man.

scene5_screen36.text: I’m sorry. For what you were made to endure. For what you lost. Lady Virena and I will learn more and update our knowledge to make the final separation between you and Lord Valentine.

scene5_screen37.text: Elena watches from a distance. Her father places a hand on Jason’s shoulder. Not hostile — approving. The knot in her chest loosens. Her fury fades, leaving something softer behind.

scene5_screen38.text: She realizes: she trusts him. And more than that… she's falling for him.

scene5_screen39.text: Lady Virena appears beside Elena — silent and graceful.

scene5_screen40.text: He’s running out of time, you know.

scene5_screen42.text: By the terms of the Old Pact, if a prince doesn’t ascend within a century of the king’s death — by claiming a mate and the throne — power defaults to the Council. That century ends in days.

scene5_screen43.text: She glides away before Elena can respond.

scene5_screen44.text: Jason rejoins her, the weight of everything heavy on his face.

scene5_screen45.text: (gently) Let’s get some rest. My blood makes it impossible for those who have not made the transition to stay awake.

scene5_screen46.text: Elena nods. One step behind him — but no longer uncertain.

scene6_screen1.text: Elena steps into the room and pauses. Despite the ominous décor and air of tradition, her gaze zeroes in on a surprisingly normal sight.

scene6_screen3.text: (smirking) Don’t make me quote Twilight. “It’s not for sleeping, Bella.”

scene6_screen4.text: Elena snorts, covering her mouth in amusement.

scene6_screen5.text: (shrugging) Sometimes, even vampires like to lie down and pretend the world isn’t watching.

scene6_screen6.text: She walks further in, each step dragging slightly. Fatigue clings to her bones, emotional and physical.

scene6_screen7.text: I’m… so tired. But happy, somehow. My father… he’s alive.

scene6_screen8.text: (softly) You got a second chance. That’s rare around here.

scene6_screen9.text: She sits on the edge of the bed, hands in her lap.

scene6_screen10.text: So, what now? We’re still bound by the pact. What does that mean?

scene6_screen11.text: Technically, we’re only bound until the engagement becomes official. I was thinking… we could announce it tomorrow. At the Initiation Ceremony.

scene6_screen12.text: (raising a brow) Is that the thing where you, like, skin a human and chant in Latin?

scene6_screen14.text: She blinks, then laughs nervously. He joins her on the bed, facing her.

scene6_screen15.text: The ceremony is old, sacred. Every human who’s survived vampire blood in the last seven days is brought forward. They must willingly take the Oath, drink their sire’s blood — mixed with the essence of bat — and choose to become one of us. No tricks. No force.

scene6_screen16.text: Elena goes quiet. Her fingers trace a pattern on the blanket.

scene6_screen17.text: What was it like for you? When you turned.

scene6_screen19.text: I was dying. The old King… he found me. Chose me. Said I had a spark he’d only seen once before. He raised me as a son. Taught me our ways, our history. We fought together in theGreat War, tried to create a more humane order. He died fighting for it. Died protecting the idea that we don’t need to be monsters.

scene6_screen21.text: That’s why you only feed from those who are already dying.

scene6_screen23.text: They share a small, heavy silence. Then Elena chuckles.

scene6_screen24.text: And here I am, dragging this out longer than anyone.

scene6_screen25.text: I don’t mind. You’re… not like the others. The Council sent me many “suitable” mates, all pre-approved, poised, and perfect. But I knew. They were planted. None of them were… you.

scene6_screen26.text: (continuing, quieter now) A vampire queen is more than a title. She’s meant to represent balance — the power of legacy, bloodline, and continuity. The Council insists the realm must be ruled equally — masculine and feminine forces in equilibrium. The last queen… she took her own life after my father died. Said she couldn’t imagine eternity without him.

scene6_screen27.text: His eyes dim with the memory, though his face remains composed.

scene6_screen28.text: Since then, they’ve been… eager to fill the void. But they never asked what I wanted. Or who I trusted enough to stand beside me.

scene6_screen30.text: And truthfully… I never thought I could be a king. I didn’t want to give up the promise I made him, but I feared I’d never be worthy.

scene6_screen31.text: You’re more than worthy. You still believe in something. That’s rare.

scene6_screen32.text: Their hands brush. A warmth flows through the contact. She looks at him.

scene6_screen33.text: I wasn’t brave. Not really. I just didn’t have the luxury of fear. I lived every day since I was twelve knowing I could die at any moment. There wasn’t time for doubt.

scene6_screen34.text: The honesty hangs in the air like a breath they’re both holding. Then Jason leans forward, and their lips meet — slow, intentional, a meeting of equals.

scene6_screen35.text: When they part, Jason’s gaze searches hers.

scene6_screen36.text: Elena… tomorrow’s ceremony. Your father wanted to undergo the ritual. Do you want to go through with it? Do you want to become one of us?

scene6_choice1_option1_screen1.text: (quietly) Yes. Having my father, my connection with you, and my new life, I think I'm becoming more than that. I was just afraid to admit it.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen2.text: Jason nods, a small smile tugging at his lips. Jason seemed to relax, and Elena felt it too. He lightly slid his fingers down her arm.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen4.text: Get some rest. We both have a big day ahead — a fake engagement to sell and possibly a rebirth to survive. I need to go hunt. I’ll order you something… human.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen5.text: Elena laughs softly, nods. After he leaves, silence settles.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen6.text: She lies back on the bed, staring at the carved ceiling above.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen7.text: So much has changed. Her father lives. She’s someone’s fiancée — technically. And tomorrow, she’ll either become immortal or step even deeper into a world she barely understands.

scene6_choice1_option1_screen8.text: But she doesn’t feel afraid. For the first time in years… she feels at peace.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen10.text: A murmur ripples through the air as vampires from every clan gather in the ceremonial hall. Towering arches frame a wide platform at the center. Along the sides, gothic banquet tables stretch endlessly, each set with obsidian goblets brimming with blood.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen11.text: Lady Virena steps forward, robed in ancient black silk, her voice echoing with command.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen12.text: Tonight, we gather for the sacred rite — an Initiation long awaited. But before we begin, our prince has asked to address the court.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen13.text: Jason emerges onto the platform. Every gaze turns to him, heavy with expectation.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen14.text: Before you stands a human… a woman I’ve chosen to walk beside me. Not out of tradition, but truth. Elena and I are engaged.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen15.text: A wave of murmurs. Shock. Disbelief.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen16.text: (steadily) She is not one of us — yet. But her courage, her will, her honesty… they surpass blood. She comes to this transformation willingly and openly, before you all. No shadows. No lies.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen17.text: The room is still. Then, applause begins — hesitant, then growing. Vampires nod with a mixture of surprise and respect.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen18.text: Elena steps forward. The candles catch her face — pale, but luminous. The crowd is silent, expectant. Even the chandeliers seem to flicker in rhythm with her heartbeat — her last heartbeat. Her voice does not tremble.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen19.text: (earnestly, heart wide open) Before tonight, I thought I wouldn’t live to see another month. I thought my story would end in a hospital bed, alone. And yet… here I am. Standing in the hall of immortals. I found my father again. I was saved by a prince who offered me not pity — but a choice.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen20.text: And now you honor me with your acceptance. I never imagined I’d belong in a place like this. But I want to. I want to learn, to grow, to become someone worthy of this ancient lineage. I vow to carry the title with respect. To defend this world, not just walk through it. And to never take for granted the second life I’ve been given.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen21.text: There’s a moment of stillness. Then, surprisingly, Lady Virena — the oldest, most unreadable face in the room — allows a smile to ghost across her lips. The crowd reacts subtly: some with approving murmurs, others with the softest of nods. Acceptance. From vampires. From legends.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen22.text: Jason watches Elena like she’s the only light in the hall.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen23.text: (quietly) Thank you. For allowing me this honor. I am ready.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen24.text: The ritual begins. Elena steps toward the obsidian platform, her bare feet echoing softly against the crystal floor. The altar gleams under candlelight — silver, etched with glyphs older than memory.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen25.text: Lady Virena lifts a chalice crafted of onyx and bone, its contents dark and glimmering.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen26.text: Jason steps beside her, offering his palm. With a ceremonial blade, he slices across his skin, blood blooming rich and red. It drips into the chalice — mixing with the ancient essence, the catalyst of transformation.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen27.text: (voice like velvet and steel) May the blood carry you. May the night accept you.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen28.text: Elena takes the chalice in both hands. Her reflection in the surface is the last time she sees herself as human.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen30.text: The moment the blood touches her tongue, fire ignites in her throat, in her chest, her limbs. Her vision whitewashes — then floods with color too sharp to bear. Every heartbeat feels like thunder and breaking glass.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen31.text: She drops to her knees. A scream tears from her lips — not of pain, but of unmaking. Her human self disintegrates in real time, atom by atom. And then—

scene7_choice0_option1_screen32.text: Silence. Breath. Her eyes open. She sees shadows moving in slow motion. Smells of candle wax and iron, and rose oil. Hears someone blink on the far side of the room.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen36.text: Lady Virena steps forward once more, her tone less formal, almost… warm.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen37.text: Welcome, Elena. May your second life be as noble as your words.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen38.text: Applause rises — quiet, dignified, but undeniable.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen39.text: Jason helps Elena to her feet, steadying her with a hand at her back. They remain side by side as Virena continues the ceremony, presenting new initiates. But all eyes stray toward the couple — the prince and the girl who drank his blood freely.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen40.text: They sit together at the head of the table. Not as strangers. Not as a scandal. But as the beginning of something new.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen41.text: Their fingers remain linked, even when no one is watching.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen42.text: Elena stands among the silent flora, breath steady, skin humming with new life. Jason approaches, carrying a blood pouch.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen43.text: (gentle) You’ll be hungry. This one’s for you — vintage blend. A gift.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen45.text: Classy. You’re not just a prince, you’re a sommelier of gore.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen46.text: You’ve crossed the threshold. The pact is fulfilled. You’re free now.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen47.text: Elena sips, then lowers the pouch.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen48.text: (serious) But what about you? They still want to take your power. Lady Virena told me about the 100-year rule.

scene7_choice0_option1_screen50.text: I was going to ask for more time…

scene7_choice0_option1_screen51.text: (cutting in) Don’t. Time won’t fix what’s unresolved. It's time for you to take action for your life. What do you want, Jason? Rule? Relinquish? Run?

scene7_choice0_option1_screen52.text: He looks at her — the fire in her eyes, the quiet command in her voice. Then, at last — he answers.

scene7_choice1_option1_screen1.text: (inspired, firm look) I want you as my wife — not just in name or to appease the Council, but because you changed me. You reminded me what purpose feels like.

scene7_choice1_option1_screen2.text: I’ve spent a century fighting shadows, doubting I could ever be the leader this realm needs. But with you by my side — your clarity, your courage, the way you face everything head-on — I know now: we can be something different.

scene7_choice1_option1_screen3.text: He steps closer, takes both her hands in his.

scene7_choice1_option1_screen4.text: We’ll rule the vampire world not through fear, but strength. Not through tradition, but vision. With my knowledge and your fire, we’ll reshape what it means to wear the crown. Be my queen, Elena — not just of title, but of blood, of heart, of night.

scene7_choice1_option1_screen5.text: Elena stares at him — breathless, her eyes wide. Then, slowly, she smiles, fierce and luminous. Their lips meet in a kiss not just of passion, but unity — a pact sealed by love and ambition.

scene8.text: The Wedding of the Night Court
scene8.title: Scene 7

scene8_choice0_option1_screen7.text: A hush falls over the court. In the center of the obsidian hall, beneath high-vaulted ceilings and blood-red banners, stand two figures bathed in the glow of ancient fire. Elena has changed - now she is a vampire and the future queen of the night, dressed in a new outfit of red velvet and the confidence of a long life. Jason, regal in tailored black and crimson, his gaze locked only on her.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen8.text: Before them — the Black Altar. Etched with runes. Steeped in ancient history.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen9.text: (formal, solemn) Before the court of immortals… under the gaze of the First Night… Do you, Prince Jason of House Virex, swear to guide our realm with justice, strength, and unwavering loyalty to the Covenant of Shadows?

scene8_choice0_option1_screen10.text: (calm, powerful) I do. With blood and will, I vow.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen11.text: And do you, Elena, chosen of flame and fate, swear to stand as Queen beside him — to protect the weak, uphold the pact, and bring dignity to our name?

scene8_choice0_option1_screen12.text: (clear, steady) I do. With heart and fire, I vow.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen13.text: They each place a hand over a twin-blade forged of sunken moon-metal, their blood mingling on the hilt. A single drop falls onto the altar.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen14.text: A pulse of magic answers — ancient, approving.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen15.text: By night and oath, you are bound. By flame and fang, you are wed. All hail the King and Queen of the Night Court.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen16.text: The court erupts in applause — subtle, echoing like rain on stone. The couple kisses beneath the stained-glass eye of the moon.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen18.text: The kingdom remembers their wedding as the turning point — the moment the shadows were tempered with grace.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen19.text: Elena sits tall beside Jason, her presence radiant. No longer the frightened girl on the edge of death. Now — a Queen with purpose, clarity, and a fire in her chest that never dimmed. Jason rules with wisdom, tempered by her compassion.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen20.text: Elena’s father, now titled Lord Thorne, serves as High Advisor for Pact Integrity — uncovering and dissolving corrupt blood bonds and illegal feedings.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen21.text: Lady Virena, still poised and eternal, is now Elena’s closest counsel. She teaches her the nuances of diplomacy between vampires and humans, and quietly admits, one night, that she has not smiled as often in centuries.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen22.text: Together, Jason and Elena rewrite the code of their kind. Sanctuaries for peaceful coexistence. Trials for those who abuse the blood laws. A new generation of immortals taught not only to hunt, but to protect.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen23.text: And through it all — their bond only deepens. Not perfect. Not easy. But real. They are not simply King and Queen.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen24.text: They are partners. They are a promise fulfilled.

scene8_choice0_option1_screen25.text: They are love, reborn in darkness… and burning brighter than ever.

scene8_choice0_option2_screen1.text: (quietly, with relief) I don’t want the crown anymore. I never truly did. For years, I told myself I was biding my time, waiting for the right moment to pass the torch… but really, I was just afraid of what it would mean to let go.

scene8_choice0_option2_screen2.text: Now, seeing you — how brave you’ve been, how free you are even in transformation — I understand what I’ve been denying myself.

scene8_choice0_option2_screen3.text: He looks to the stars above the garden.

scene8_choice0_option2_screen4.text: Virena is ready. She’s powerful, wise, and loyal to our people. The realm doesn’t need a reluctant king — it needs someone who chooses it fully. But me? I choose something else now. I choose freedom. I choose you.

scene8_choice0_option2_screen5.text: Elena nods gently, her fingers finding his. Their kiss is soft, a silent promise to walk forward as equals — no crowns, no thrones, just two souls finally unburdened.

scene9_choice0_option2_screen6.text: The room falls silent as Jason steps forward. Clad in ceremonial black, he raises his hand — not to command, but to speak.

scene9_choice0_option2_screen7.text: (steady, resolute) I didn’t summon this emergency session lightly. Tonight, I relinquish my claim to the throne.

scene9_choice0_option2_screen8.text: Gasps ripple through the chamber. The Council stirs. Even Lady Virena’s brow lifts slightly.

scene9_choice0_option2_screen9.text: Power was never my goal. I see now that strength lies not in one ruler… but in the many. Lady Virena has shown a wisdom and fairness that this kingdom needs. The world is changing. And I believe the Council — under her guidance — will lead us with dignity.

scene9_choice0_option2_screen10.text: He places the seal of the crown on the obsidian pedestal. No one stops him.

scene9_choice0_option2_screen11.text: They only watch as a new era begins.

scene9_choice0_option3_screen1.text: (the look is soft, the lips tremble in a smile) I want to leave. Just… leave. No goodbyes, no speeches, no politics. You and I — disappear into the world and find out what it means to live without duty clawing at our backs.

scene9_choice0_option3_screen2.text: I’ve been a prince for too long. But with you, I remembered who I used to be — someone curious, reckless, even joyful.

scene9_choice0_option3_screen3.text: He takes a step forward, touches a lock of her hair.

scene9_choice0_option3_screen4.text: Let’s vanish. Wander through cities that don’t know our names. Rent boats, dance in alleys, hunt in moonlight, laugh like mortals. Let’s be legends no one can prove existed. No more war rooms. No more rituals. Just us — two creatures of the night, stealing back pieces of life.

scene9_choice0_option3_screen5.text: Elena lets out a breathless laugh, one hand to her chest. Their kiss is wild, tender, and desperate with relief. In that moment, neither crown nor bloodline matters — only the journey ahead.

scene10_choice0_option3_screen7.text: (composed, but warm) Jason and Elena have married — in private. Their time has passed quietly, with grace. The window of succession has closed. As decreed by the laws of old, rule now passes to the Council.

scene10_choice0_option3_screen8.text: She places a single black rose on the royal seal — a symbol of peaceful transfer.

scene10_choice0_option3_screen9.text: I accept the role of Chair of the Council. And I vow to lead not as a queen… but as a servant of balance.

scene10_choice0_option3_screen10.text: No crown is lifted. But power shifts, felt through the walls of the ancient hall.

scene10_screen1.text: Jason and Elena sit at a small table, red wine in hand. No crowns. No obligations.

scene10_screen2.text: Just laughter. Tonight, they dine as guests of Vlad himself — the old vampire king who never quite retired.

scene10_screen3.text: Elena leans into Jason, her eyes alight with freedom. He brushes a kiss to her knuckles, smiling in a way he never could inside palace walls.

scene10_screen4.text: Now and then, they hear whispers of new laws, bold reforms, and Council debates. But it feels distant — like a storm that passed.

scene10_screen5.text: They have eternity. And more importantly — they have each other.

scene10_screen6.text: Their story no longer belongs to the court. It belongs to them.

scene10_choice0_option2_screen1.text: Not yet. Maybe never. But… thank you. For giving me the choice.

scene10_choice0_option2_screen2.text: Jason presses a kiss to her hand — reverent, not disappointed.

scene10_choice0_option2_screen4.text: Get some rest. We both have a big day ahead — a fake engagement to sell and possibly a rebirth to survive. I need to go hunt. I’ll order you something… human.

scene10_choice0_option2_screen5.text: Elena laughs softly, nods. After he leaves, silence settles.

scene10_choice0_option2_screen6.text: She lies back on the bed, staring at the carved ceiling above.

scene10_choice0_option2_screen7.text: So much has changed. Her father lives. She’s someone’s fiancée — technically. And tomorrow, she’ll either become immortal or step even deeper into a world she barely understands.

scene10_choice0_option2_screen8.text: But she doesn’t feel afraid. For the first time in years… she feels at peace.

scene11_choice0_option2_screen10.text: The hum of anticipation. The crowd gathers. At the center, Lady Virena steps onto the raised obsidian platform, her presence commanding.

scene11_choice0_option2_screen11.text: Tonight, we welcome new souls into our eternal ranks. But before the ritual begins… The Prince has a personal announcement.

scene11_choice0_option2_screen12.text: Jason steps forward. Every eye turns. He holds Elena's hand.

scene11_choice0_option2_screen13.text: (clearly, firmly) This is Elena. She is not a vampire. But she is my fiancée. And though she chooses to remain mortal, I have chosen her — completely.

scene11_choice0_option2_screen14.text: A wave of murmurs. Shock. Whispers echo like thunder across the hall.

scene11_choice0_option2_screen15.text: No law forbids a prince from marrying a human. You may not understand it. You may not accept it now. But this is my choice — and hers.

scene11_choice0_option2_screen16.text: The room is still. A few angry glances. Some unsure nods. Lady Virena tilts her head, considering.

scene11_choice0_option2_screen17.text: (measured) The matter will be brought before the Council. But tonight — is not about politics.

scene11_choice0_option2_screen20.text: Jason and Elena step aside, standing as honored guests — but not participants. One by one, new initiates kneel. The ritual continues.

scene11_choice0_option2_screen21.text: Elena steps away from the festivities, only to be met by a figure emerging from the shadows — her father. He embraces her, warm and real.

scene11_choice0_option2_screen22.text: You made the right choice. Thank you… for staying you.

scene11_choice0_option2_screen23.text: Tears threaten, but she smiles instead. Later, Jason finds her near the fountain, his expression unreadable.

scene11_choice0_option2_screen24.text: The pact is complete. You're free now.

scene11_choice0_option2_screen26.text: The Council may still demand answers. I hoped I could buy more time, but…

scene11_choice0_option2_screen27.text: (interrupts gently) Jason. You keep avoiding the real question. What do you want? To rule? To step away? Or to walk away from it all?

opts.text: I want you, just as you are
I was never meant to rule

scene11_choice1_option1_screen1.text: (earnestly) Elena, I used to believe that the Queen of the Night had to be one of us — a vampire by blood, by tradition. But now I know… your humanity isn’t a flaw. It’s your greatest strength. You remind me why we exist in the first place — not for power or legacy, but for meaning.

scene11_choice1_option1_screen2.text: You are my clarity, my balance. My heart. I want you to be my wife. Not a vampire queen by lineage — but my queen by choice. Together, we can rule — you as you are, and I as I am. You’ll be the bridge between our worlds. With your heart and my history, we’ll build something this kingdom has never seen.

scene11_choice1_option1_screen3.text: Let them challenge it. Let them doubt us. But I will stand beside you — always. Say yes… and let the old rules burn.

scene11_choice1_option1_screen4.text: He reaches into his coat and pulls out a ring — not ancient, but his. A promise. Elena looks at it, then at him… and she sees it. Trust. Faith. Love. She nods — and smiles like dawn breaking after a long night.

scene12.text: Until the End of Her Days
scene12.title: Epilogue

scene12_choice0_option1_screen6.text: The grand hall is dressed in shadows and candlelight. Crimson roses spill across the floor like spilled wine.

scene12_choice0_option1_screen7.text: Tonight, not just a wedding — a vow to two realms. To the crown of the night… and the fleeting warmth of mortality.

scene12_choice0_option1_screen8.text: (officiating) Tonight, we witness the union of Prince Jason of House Thorne and Lady Elena of the Mortal Line. Bound not by blood alone, but by choice — and by love that dares to challenge tradition.

scene12_choice0_option1_screen9.text: (to Elena, hand over heart) I vow to protect our realm and to walk beside you, in shadow and light, for as long as your heart beats in this world.

scene12_choice0_option1_screen10.text: (to Jason, voice trembling but steady) And I vow to give what time I have freely, fiercely. To honor this kingdom, and you — until my final breath.

scene12_choice0_option1_screen11.text: The vow is sealed with a kiss, tender and solemn. The court applauds, hesitant at first — then rising like a tide. The Queen of the Night is human… and yet, never has the throne felt so complete.

scene12_choice0_option1_screen12.text: Years unfolded like silk — filled with challenge and change. Elena proved herself a queen not by blood, but by conviction. She spoke for the voiceless and bridged ancient tensions. Her father, now a trusted advisor, oversaw vampire pacts with wisdom and precision.

scene12_choice0_option1_screen13.text: Lady Virena, once skeptical, became her closest confidante — guiding her through the political tides between humans and immortals.

scene12_choice0_option1_screen14.text: The vampire court adjusted. They didn’t give Elena everything — but they gave her enough. Enough trust. Enough space. A human queen for a realm of eternal beings. A compromise. A miracle.

scene12_choice0_option1_screen15.text: Elena died at seventy — peacefully, surrounded by loved ones, her hand in Jason’s. The court mourned, for she had become more than queen. She had become a legend.

scene12_choice0_option1_screen16.text: Jason stood over her grave for three nights. Then, when the moon was new, he summoned the court.

scene12_choice0_option1_screen17.text: (calm, tired) I have ruled long enough. It is time for new blood to take the throne.

scene12_choice0_option1_screen18.text: He handed the crown to the chosen heir. Not with sorrow — but with peace. For Jason had known eternity… and chose love instead.

scene12_choice0_option1_screen19.text: One throne now stands empty. The other, once his, was surrendered by a man who gave up everything for a single lifetime well spent.

scene12_choice0_option2_screen1.text: (calm, resolute) I’ve been holding on to this crown for over a century — out of duty, out of fear. But I see it clearly now. This kingdom doesn’t need a reluctant prince. It needs someone who believes. Lady Virena is wise, fair, and brave enough to lead without ego. She listens, she acts.

scene12_choice0_option2_screen2.text: And me? I’ve played my part. Now it’s time to let go. You reminded me that strength isn’t in control — it’s in knowing when to release it. I’ll step down. Hand the throne to those who truly want to shape the future.

scene12_choice0_option2_screen3.text: You saved me from a lifetime of pretending. And for that, I’ll be forever grateful.

scene12_choice0_option2_screen4.text: He gently kisses her forehead — no fanfare, just truth. The torch has passed, and he feels lighter than he has in years. The world shifts — and he finally lets it.

scene13_choice0_option2_screen6.text: (calm, resolute) I summoned this emergency council not for ceremony… but for closure. Today, I surrender the crown. Not out of fear, nor failure. But because I’ve chosen love.

scene13_choice0_option2_screen7.text: Elena showed me the strength in humanity — the kind even centuries of immortality could not teach. Lady Virena has proven herself fair, wise, and deeply respected. I believe the Council, under her guidance, will lead with clarity and justice.

scene13_choice0_option2_screen8.text: As for me... I will walk a different path. One not lit by power, but by the life we choose — together.

scene13_choice0_option2_screen9.text: Gasps, then a heavy pause. Some dissent, some nods. But no one dares speak against him.

scene13_choice0_option3_screen1.text: (softly, intimately) I’ve spent decades bound by duty. Bound by legacy. But you? You make me want something I thought I lost long ago.

scene13_choice0_option3_screen2.text: A life. A real one. Not filled with courts and politics, but… nights under foreign skies. Mornings with no plans. We could vanish.

scene13_choice0_option3_screen3.text: Just you and me, wandering the world. No guards. No rules. Just freedom — and the eternal time to live it. Let’s run, Elena. Not away, but toward something real. I don’t want to rule. I just want you.

scene13_choice0_option3_screen4.text: She stares at him, heart pounding. No royal decree. No grand future. Just love. When she leans into his arms, the world feels full — and theirs.

scene14_choice0_option3_screen6.text: As of this evening, Prince Jason and Lady Elena have departed the kingdom. Their marriage was private, their choice final. They sought no ceremony, no farewell.

scene14_choice0_option3_screen7.text: With the passing of the succession deadline, and by our laws, the Council shall now govern in full. I, Lady Virena, will serve as its voice and steward.

scene14_choice0_option3_screen8.text: She raises her hand in solemn vow. The hall is quiet. Power shifts — silently, permanently.

scene14_screen1.text: They sit across from one another — not royalty, not legends — just two souls finally free. Jason watches as Elena laughs over a glass of wine, her eyes alight with something no court ever gave her: peace.

scene14_screen2.text: No guards. No advisors. Just the scent of red wine, fresh bread, and passing strangers. Sometimes, news finds him — letters from Elena’s father, notes of political shifts from the Council. Jason reads them with a faint smile… then tucks them away.

scene14_screen3.text: Because that world — the world of thrones, shadows, and immortal duty — is behind him.

scene14_screen4.text: And this one — fleeting, fragile, and beautifully human — is everything he needs.

scene14_screen5.text: They toast to nowhere in particular. To forever, however long it may be.
